decisions.briefing: Markets edged higher today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up 0.6%, a mild risk-on tone. With 3 open slots and $889 in cash, we deployed into NVAX, AUGO, and CAI — the only candidates showing all four bullish confirmation signals (RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and volume surge).

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted modestly higher today, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 gaining 0.6% in a broad, low-volatility advance. No single catalyst stood out; the move looked like steady buying interest continuing to support risk assets. Breadth favored growth and momentum names, consistent with the risk-on classification.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股溫和走高，納斯達克指數及標普500指數同步上升0.6%，走勢屬於低波動的穩步上揚。市場並無單一重大消息推動，更多是資金持續流入風險資產所致。成長股及強勢股表現相對領先，符合「風險偏好」的市況定調。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of buying on a single bullish hint, strong traders wait for several indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume — to all point the same direction at once. This reduces the chance of chasing a false signal and increases confidence that real buying interest is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 與其單憑一個看漲訊號就進場，穩健的交易者會等待多項指標（例如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢及成交量）同時發出一致的看漲訊號。這樣可以減低追逐假訊號的風險，並提高背後確實有真實買盤支持這波動的信心。
